import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 32;
    static final int MAXB = 60;
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;
    static final long INF = 2_000_000_000_000_000_000L;

    static void fixValue(long[] x) {
        for (int i = 0; i < x.length; i++) {
            if (x[i] >= MOD) x[i] -= MOD;
            if (x[i] < 0) x[i] += MOD;
        }
    }

    static class Mat {
        int size;
        long[][] v;

        Mat(int n, int fill) {
            size = n;
            v = new long[size][size];
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < size; j++) {
                    v[i][j] = (i == j) ? fill : 0;
                }
            }
        }

        long[] getRow(int i) {
            return v[i];
        }

        Mat multiply(Mat b) {
            Mat res = new Mat(size, 0);
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < size; j++) {
                    for (int k = 0; k < size; k++) {
                        res.v[i][k] += v[i][j] * b.v[j][k] % MOD;
                        res.v[i][k] %= MOD;
                    }
                }
            }
            return res;
        }

        Mat add(Mat b) {
            Mat res = new Mat(size, 0);
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < size; j++) {
                    res.v[i][j] = v[i][j] + b.v[i][j];
                }
            }
            return res;
        }

        boolean equals(Mat b) {
            if (size != b.size) return false;
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < size; j++) {
                    if (v[i][j] != b.v[i][j]) return false;
                }
            }
            return true;
        }
    }

    static Mat fastExponentiation(Mat base, long exp) {
        Mat result = new Mat(base.size, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < base.size; i++) {
            result.v[i][i] = 1;
        }
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                result = result.multiply(base);
            }
            base = base.multiply(base);
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        int k = sc.nextInt();

        long[] val = new long[MAXB];
        Arrays.fill(val, 1);

            if (val[i - 1] >= INF / k) {

                lastIdx = i;
                break;
            }
            val[i] = val[i - 1] * k;
        }

        List<Mat> shift = new ArrayList<>();
        shift.add(new Mat(k + 1, 1));
        Mat shift1 = new Mat(k + 1, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            shift1.v[i][(i - 1 + k) % k] = 1;
        }
        shift1.v[k][k] = 1;
        shift.add(shift1);

        System.out.println(res);
        sc.close();
